title: Rudolph Eglin and the rival Washington bands
summary: He joined Rudolph Eglin's band, and describes Washington's neighbourhood jazz bands (Sam Taylor's, Cyrus Carter's Jazzhounds) and their tunes, and hearing high-note trumpeter Henry Goodman before he knew Louis Armstrong.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: well, he loved life, so I got in his band and --

He plays everything. He plays soprano sax and he played piano and could arrange, now during this time Duke he was in Deanwood, see, now the big bands, Claude Hopkins, he was a big band, and then they had a band called Sam Taylor's and Sam Taylor would give you a little trouble and they had one called Cyrus Carter's Jazzhounds. Those days they had -- they all had names, just awful names. Blues Stompers, Barefoot Ramblers and one band was named Sam somebody and his Yarddogs.

So now Sam Taylor, he was -- you don't go in Southwest and bother Sam Taylor, he'd get you and this -- and Cyrus Carter, he'd get you if you go in Northwest, so that was -- and then they had the White Brothers, they were society. You didn't bother with me, and they all read music. Cyrus Carter wasn't studying about no music, and was swinging and going on --
What kind of tunes did they play?

They had one called 'Senorita Mine.' (Humming) and they tore that 'Senorita' up and swung it to death. 'Blind Man' And (humming) I think the _____Blues' and you can't get a monkey go get yourself a shimmyback, down at Shimmy Hall.' So and these cats, and I was going and listening to them, so there was a fellow there named Henry Goodman, oh, my goodness, he'd hit high C, and that was the first time I ever heard -- Henry Goodman -- he had his style and he was popping those notes, so
I hadn't heard Louis Armstrong yet, so then I go to the theatre I kept listenting to that clarinet there and it was moving me, but I couldn't get away from that trumpet.
How do you spell his name.
So I got what I need from Rudolph, I was playing polinaises and then there was a --
